decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and native structures outside the joint support remain unchanged, without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: This is mask-only annotation-conditioned evidence within an uncalibrated research envelope, not generated-H&E, histologic truth or clinical validation.
